The '''Danalbeth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danalbeth]].
